reuse.why: Consolidates the six provider link functions into one linkBankAccount/saveLinkedAccount path that carries the duplicate-link, closed-account and takeover rules, but the Fintegra download copies downloadAkahuTransactions and the takeover re-writes unlinkAccount's field clearing instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: Removes large per-provider duplication in app.ts, yet adds a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions as downloadFintegraTransactions and a second copy of unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount clearing block.

placement.why: Link rules live in accounts/app.ts and the download in accounts/sync.ts with the other providers, though provider-specific field mapping (goCardless mask/official_name) is pushed into the generic saveLinkedAccount.

scope.why: Everything serves the four steps, but the full rewrite of all provider link functions is a broad refactor beyond what any single step strictly required.

maintainability.why: One linking path makes the rules hard to miss for future providers; the remaining copies (download function, unlink fields) and the goCardless special case inside the shared saver are the weak spots.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts linkBankAccount clears the replaced holders with its own db.updateAccount field list instead of a shared helper with unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions (sync.ts) and the unlink clearing loop in linkBankAccount are verbatim copies, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankAccount gains replaceExistingLink (besides fileId/tables carrying pre-existing provider differences); saveLinkedAccount has a syncSource === 'goCardless' branch; the takeover loop re-implements unlinkAccount's clearing.
